key_highlights: 30-year mortgage rates hit 13-month high; mortgage stress at 18-year peak, signalling severe household balance-sheet pressure
Aussie banks forecast record house price declines; CBA reports 15% drop in home loan applications since budget
Fourth RBA rate hike looms amid inflation concerns; economy narrowly avoids recession but productivity 'bad to worse'
Banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC) led ASX 200 recovery, snapping three-day losing streak
Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test; Lindian secures 20-year Kazakhstan rare earths offtake; multiple ASX miners advance exploration
TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel scrutiny intensifies
Global equities surge as rate-hike bets pared; Broadcom AI revenue ramp and Nvidia commentary support tech sentiment
Persian Gulf tanker fires pose oil supply risk; El Niño flagged as strongest in decades
Regional doctors strike over poor conditions; childcare chain closures continue

sectors.trend: Banks led ASX 200 recovery but face structural headwinds: record house price fall forecasts, 15% drop in loan applications, 18-year high mortgage stress, and a looming fourth RBA hike. Net interest margin expansion offset by credit-loss provisioning risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX may see near-term NIM support from rate hikes but elevated NPLs and falling loan volumes cap upside. Dividend sustainability under pressure.

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust: Macarthur clears WA iron ore bulk test, Lindian locks 20-year rare earths offtake, Dalaroo drills 12,000m in Africa, True North expands Qld copper, PLC targets WA Murchison gold. Iron ore and rare earths remain strategic priorities.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from iron ore demand but face China slowdown risk. Small-caps (LND.AX, DLR.AX, TRN.AX, PLC.AX, CRG.AX) offer asymmetric upside on exploration success.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo faces gas cartel scrutiny; One Nation pushes to keep coal plant open; Chinese solar capacity overtakes coal globally. Energy transition costs mounting.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, BOQ.AX face policy uncertainty. TMK.AX benefits from gas price spike. Coal exposure (WDS.AX) under political pressure. LNG majors (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from Persian Gulf supply disruption.

sectors.trend: Record house price fall forecasts (up to 10% decline) and 15% drop in loan applications create severe downside risk for residential REITs and construction names. Melbourne councils admit inability to cope with population growth.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICQ.AX, DUA.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Construction (WBC.AX exposure, WES.AX) sees delayed project pipelines. Defensive rotation likely.

sectors.trend: Hundreds of regional doctors strike over poor conditions; childcare chain shuts another Canberra centre; Ozempic maker in trouble with tablet alternatives emerging. Consumer stress from mortgage costs.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WES.AX face operational disruption risk. CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WDW.AX) benefit from rate-sensitive consumer pullback.

sectors.trend: Broadcom Q3 beats but barely; AI revenue ramp forecast steep; Nvidia confirms AI boom continues; Meta gains AI catalyst. Global tech surge supports sentiment but valuations stretched.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WTC.AX, XRO.AX, SVL.AX) benefits from global AI capex cycle but remains small-cap. US tech strength supports AUD and risk appetite.

key_themes: Housing crisis: record price fall forecasts, 18-year mortgage stress peak, 15% loan application drop
RBA policy: fourth rate hike imminent; inflation vs recession trade-off
Productivity deterioration: 'bad to worse' trajectory threatens long-term growth
Commodity exploration: iron ore, rare earths, gold, copper pipeline expanding
Energy transition friction: gas cartel, coal politics, solar overtaking coal in China
Geopolitical supply risk: Persian Gulf tanker fires, El Niño agricultural impact
Global AI capex cycle: Broadcom, Nvidia, Meta drive tech momentum

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and credit losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce financials and residential REIT exposure; favour banks with lower residential loan concentration (CBA.AX, NAB.AX over ANZ.AX, WBC.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and recession risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge rate sensitivity via long-duration bonds; maintain cash buffer; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance
Energy and LNG exposure (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) as hedge; monitor Brent crude and AUD/USD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Productivity decline and structural growth impairment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour dividend-paying large caps; avoid high-multiple growth names; monitor GDP and productivity data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: El Niño agricultural and commodity impact
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor wheat, sugar, and cotton prices; consider CSL.AX, WES.AX as defensive staples
Diversify across coal, gas, and renewables; avoid single-policy-bet positions

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX energy and LNG names on Persian Gulf supply risk and gas price surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rates spiking; tanker fires in Gulf create supply premium; LNG majors benefit from structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to ASX exploration names with near-term catalysts
opportunities.rationale: Macarthur iron ore bulk test cleared; Lindian 20-year offtake locked; Dalaroo and True North advancing drilling

opportunities.recommendation: Maintain defensive healthcare and consumer staples allocation
opportunities.rationale: CSL.AX and WES.AX offer dividend yield and defensive characteristics amid housing and rate uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts and 15% loan application drop signal prolonged property downturn

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-beta financials; favour CBA and NAB over ANZ and WBC
defensive_moves.rationale: CBA and NAB have lower residential loan concentration and stronger capital buffers amid credit stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD/USD and rate risk with short-duration bonds or inverse ETFs
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD may spike on inflation but RBA hike cycle and recession risk create two-way volatility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely range-bound to modestly lower over 1–3 months. Banks provide floor support but housing data and RBA hike risk cap upside. Energy names outperform on Gulf supply risk. Expect volatility around RBA decision and CPI prints.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and housing correction weigh on growth. Mining and energy offer relative strength. Structural shift toward AI capex and rare earths supports selective tech and materials. Recession risk remains elevated but not base case.
